verdicts.reason: A puts 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' under the headline, so the reading order is backwards. Its 'RSVP Free' CTA is the same size and colour as the 'FREE ENTRY' pill in a 2x2 grid, so the CTA doesn't stand out. The subhead and date are squeezed into narrow columns, the fine print is unreadably small and the missing-asset placeholder is still visible. B keeps the kicker above the headline. But the 'RSVPFree' CTA is merged into a stack of four pills that runs from the top edge to the bottom edge, with a missing space in its label and no hierarchy. B also has tiny fine print and the same placeholder, so it is only slightly less broken than A.
